subject: Obstruction - Sechelt Inlet - Jervis Inlet
text:
Obstruction - Sechelt Inlet - Jervis Inlet
A water supply line has been reported afloat on the surface of the water in the vicinity of Skookumchuck Narrows located at 49 45.778N 123 56.541W. The supply line extends from the northern end of Sutton Island to the Sechelt Peninsula. 
Caution.
